name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v523: Cloudflare bypass now uses Phisher's AnimePahe WebView UI and flow exactly - Material BottomSheetDialogFragment, 70% height WebView, starts collapsed then slides to full at ~3s, 1s title+cookie polling, 120s timeout, stale cf_clearance/__cf_bm/cf_chl* purge, cookie harvest across mirrors, auto-save of clearance + solving User-Agent, 500ms auto-dismiss, Phisher's drawn mouse cursor. Provider, extractors and request plumbing remain CineStream's. Includes v522 wait-and-retry probe, v520 device WebView UA, movie fix (v505), rate limit caching (v506), Simkl covers (v507), TMDB logo any-language fallback (v510), fanart.tv logo fallback (v512), TMDB backdrop middle layer (v511).
